extension.description: Sync and deploy workspace files to remote servers — a fast SFTP, FTP and SSH client with upload on save, diff view, and multiple server profiles.
wireferry.upload.activeFile.to.allProfil: Upload Active File To All Profiles
wireferry.upload.activeFolder.to.allProf: Upload Active Folder To All Profiles
wireferry.debug.description: print debug log on WireFerry output channel.(reload vscode when change this)
wireferry.downloadWhenOpenInRemoteExplor: "Download" instead of "View Content" when open file in Remote Explorer
wireferry.checkForUpdates.description: Check GitHub for a newer WireFerry release on startup. Makes one HTTPS GET to api.github.com (release version only — no telemetry, nothing about you is sent). You are asked for consent once before the first check.
wireferry.suppressLegacyConfigNotice.des: Stop reminding about legacy sftp.* settings/config and unsupported configuration keys.
wireferry.alertLanguage.description: Language for WireFerry's own popup messages and prompts, independent of the VS Code display language. Default: English.
wireferry.remoteExplorer.showSize.descri: Always show file size next to the name in the Remote Explorer tree (otherwise size is shown on hover only).
wireferry.remoteExplorer.sortBySize.desc: Sort the Remote Explorer tree by size, largest first, with folders and files as separate groups. Folder sizes are measured on the server with `du` (SFTP only; FTP and servers without `du` keep name order for folders).
wireferry.remoteExplorer.profilesAsRoots: When the config defines `profiles`, show every profile as its own root in the Remote Explorer (browse any server without switching the active profile). Turn off to keep a single root for the active profile only.
view.remoteExplorer.name: Explorer
view.remoteExplorer.welcome:
No remote server is configured yet.
[Create Configuration](command:wireferry.config)
The wizard asks for the host, protocol and how to store the password, then connects and creates .vscode/wireferry.json.
